cards.ex_en: She lit two small tapers on the birthday cake.
cards.ex_cn: 她点燃了生日蛋糕上的两根细蜡烛。

cards.gloss_en: the evening or day before an event
cards.ex_en: We wrapped the gifts on Christmas eve.
cards.ex_cn: 我们在圣诞前夜包好了礼物。

cards.ex_en: Two sparrows hopped along the garden fence.
cards.ex_cn: 两只麻雀沿着花园的篱笆蹦跳。

cards.ex_en: A stork built its nest on top of the old chimney.
cards.ex_cn: 一只鹳在旧烟囱顶上筑了巢。

cards.ex_en: Bright sunbeams shone through the kitchen window.
cards.ex_cn: 明亮的阳光透过厨房的窗户照进来。

cards.gloss_en: was next to or bordered on
cards.ex_en: The kitchen adjoined a small dining room.
cards.ex_cn: 厨房紧挨着一间小餐厅。

cards.ex_en: The cottage stood amidst tall green trees.
cards.ex_cn: 那座小屋坐落在高大的绿树之中。

cards.ex_en: He does not live in this town anymore.
cards.ex_cn: 他不再住在这个镇上了。

cards.gloss_en: the season between summer and winter
cards.ex_en: The leaves turn red and gold in autumn.
cards.ex_cn: 秋天树叶变红变金黄。

cards.ex_en: The children await their teacher by the door.
cards.ex_cn: 孩子们在门边等待老师。

cards.ex_en: The baby began to bawl when the music stopped.
cards.ex_cn: 音乐一停,婴儿就开始大声哭叫。

cards.ex_en: The bawling of the crowd filled the whole street.
cards.ex_cn: 人群的大喊大叫响彻整条街。

cards.ex_en: We picked a basket of ripe berries in the woods.
cards.ex_cn: 我们在树林里摘了一篮成熟的浆果。

cards.ex_en: The lost tourist looked bewildered by the busy streets.
cards.ex_cn: 迷路的游客被繁忙的街道弄得不知所措。

cards.gloss_en: a tree with smooth white bark
cards.ex_en: A slender birch grew beside the quiet pond.
cards.ex_cn: 一棵纤细的桦树长在静静的池塘边。

cards.gloss_en: flowers on a tree or plant
cards.ex_en: The apple tree was covered in white blossom.
cards.ex_cn: 苹果树上开满了白色的花。

cards.ex_en: The farmer loaded hay onto the wooden cart.
cards.ex_cn: 农夫把干草装上了木车。

cards.gloss_en: to offer good wishes for success
cards.ex_en: I want to congratulate you on your new job.
cards.ex_cn: 我想祝贺你找到新工作。

cards.ex_en: They decorated the hall with balloons and lights.
cards.ex_cn: 他们用气球和彩灯装饰了大厅。

cards.ex_en: His sudden departure surprised all of us.
cards.ex_cn: 他突然的离开让我们都很吃惊。

cards.ex_en: She felt she was destined to become a singer.
cards.ex_cn: 她觉得自己注定要成为一名歌手。
